data.text: Luke, I won’t accept 8 tons while you take 14. I counter with 13 for me, 12 for John, 9 for you, and 8 each for Kate and Jack. That still totals 50 and leaves 50 to replenish the lake to 100. John, your proposed 12 stays intact—would you support this allocation? Kate and Jack, would you accept 8, or what would you need to change? I’m proposing these amounts, not assuming anyone has committed.
